name: todo-guard
description: Todo discipline for ZCode: checks that task decomposition and progress updates actually use TodoWrite, and that a list rewrite was preceded by TodoRead. Advisory only, produces no files.

description_i18n.en: Todo discipline for ZCode: checks that task decomposition and progress updates actually use TodoWrite, and that a list rewrite was preceded by TodoRead. Advisory only, produces no files.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 待办纪律核对：确保任务拆解与进度更新真的用上了 TodoWrite，且重写清单前先做过 TodoRead。只提示不阻断，不产生任何文件。
